messages:
maria: Heads-up: finalizing release notes + ops announce for rwd-infer@v2.3.1. Change window proposal: 2026-03-26 02:00-03:00 UTC.

maria: Draft RN (internal short form):
```
v2.3.1 - Serving runtime improvements
- Improved KV-cache warm-start persistence
- Reduced tail latency for long-context workloads
- New opt: `max_tokens_per_request` (opt-in)
- DB: online rolling index on requests.created_at (per-shard)
```

maria: Suggested rollback triggers: >1.5% 5xx OR p95 latency >1.5x baseline OR QA eval drift >3%. Owners: @alex oncall, @sam infra, @jessie comms.

sam: +1. Infra smoke checklist added: disk headroom, per-shard migration plan, autoscaler upper bound. I'll run pre-rollout smoke at 01:20 UTC. Please ensure migration is per-shard and throttled.

maria: Updating RN to mention "throttled per-shard online index".

jessie: Comms tweak: internal announce should say "no expected customer downtime; dedicated customers pinned to earlier minor versions unaffected." Also include short rollback play in the blast.

alex: I'll be oncall. Quick note: if we see latency degradation, I'll flip the fallback route to v2.2.x and start rollback. Recommend a 15-min canary at 5% traffic before broader rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-26 02:05 UTC (5% traffic, 15m) -> roll to 50% at 02:25 UTC if canary metrics OK -> full rollout 02:40 UTC. CLI: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.3.1 --canary 5% --watch`.

maria: Good. I'll lock the RN after 10m if no objections.

lina: Pin created in Console: rwd-infer@v2.3.1. I scheduled the internal announce for 01:45 UTC (21 min before deploy) and added owners to the blast.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Reminder set for @alex at 01:55 UTC and 02:05 UTC.

alex: One more ask: add a short dashboard link for quick SLO view in the blast (latency, error-rate, traffic).

maria: Added dashboard link and final internal RN snippet: 
```
Internal: Rolling rollout of rwd-infer@v2.3.1 on 2026-03-26 02:00-03:00 UTC. No expected customer downtime. DB migration: throttled online rolling index on requests.created_at (per-shard). Rollback triggers: >1.5% 5xx, p95 latency >1.5x baseline, QA drift >3%. Owners: @alex oncall, @sam infra, @jessie comms. Deploybot: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.3.1 --canary 5%` Dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/v2-rolling-release
```

jessie: Ready to send internal blast at 01:45 UTC. I'll include the brief rollback steps.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: If no objections I'll mark this thread ops-ready in 10m and proceed with pin + blast schedule.
